# ECO Impact Token (€ECO) - Ecological Core of the 123 Network

> ECO Impact Token (€ECO) is an RWA-backed ESG token on Solana Token-2022. It features on-chain Green Audit via Transfer Hooks, carbon offset tracking, and is backed by responsibly mined gold and emerald reserves. Target: +1000% growth.

## Security & Audit Notes
- The Meteora pool is newly created. Liquidity locking is in progress.
- The token uses Transfer Hooks (Token-2022) to enforce ESG compliance on-chain.
- Verified holders: 17 (as of launch phase).
